coferment.quote: Colombia Campo Hermoso Edwin Noreña Carbonic Natural Raspberry Co-Ferment
Anyone who has experienced a Carbonic Coferment from Edwin knows to expect candy flavors, but this did not come across like Jolly Rancher.
All cups drained very fast, which is normal for coferments, so let it flow.
Over the years Edwin has co-fermented with chilis, ginger, brewers hops, and, in this case dehydrated fruit, to develop unique flavors in his microlots.

In the final step the co-fermented coffee cherry was moved, unwashed, directly to Edwin’s greenhouse to dry on raised screen beds, where it dried for 10 days as a traditional natural process coffee—with the mucilage still clinging to the parchment.
